name: runs
sql: select j.jobname, count(*) filter (where d.status='succeeded') ok, count(*) filter (where d.status<>'succeeded') bad, max(d.end_time) last, (array_agg(left(d.return_message,160) order by d.runid desc) filter (where d.status<>'succeeded'))[1] last_err from cron.job j join cron.job_run_details d on d.jobid=j.jobid where j.jobname in ('ten280-bet105-drop-bot','ten287-superbet-drop-bot') and d.start_time >= now() - interval '10 minutes' group by 1

name: defs
sql: select p.oid::regprocedure::text f, position('drops_live' in pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) > 0 has_cut, position('cut28' in pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) > 0 has_scan_cut from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('ten280_bot','ten287_bot') and p.proname in ('load_ticks','scan')
